deprecations.what: GET / -- the bundled single-page visualizer served by the HTTP port
deprecations.replacement: the hosted studio at https://graph.samyama.cloud, which connects to this server from the browser
deprecations.note: Deprecated before this policy existed (#259, first shipped in 1.7.0). Announced on the page itself, in the OpenAPI description of getIndex and in the server's startup line; the 1.7.0 release notes do not mention it. The page said it 'will be removed in an upcoming release' without naming one; under this policy the earliest removal is 2.0.0.
